book.name: Galesia
book.title: Galesia Polho Duichon suraro Galesia gurocin idungma ‘yuha’ yongo bapiya ngo irim togoc

content: Non muyu toroc kiap ogepma nucno tong indaun indaun tongo itongitnahamon

Oröcnai, sontho kombiuya oröc soni auho wömuno togocanu, wömai woroc, amna Kunkun Yaruhon torocdec itongidangma yu ‘amna wo kiap wömuno imun fahun’ yongo kiap obingno tong imongo tongfat yengitnung. Wohong son soni woho, dogu kopotho son tonguc keuna sonu wömuno worocotmadecgon möningyit.
Son muyu nuc soni irot mongorec tong imongo mepmo soni kondonggon sumboda itongitnung. Ihoroc tongitnahinganu wömai son Duicho nongoru moröma nimogocma woroc tan bödengitnahing.
Oro, amna au yu forono muno inoin godibo töngmuna ‘noc amna ambarachon öngitno sinom itat’ yongo kombiantacma wömai yu inoi imanang inong yuantac.

Mit wömai Kopotorocho amna tungu tunguhon youpno angsoworengga inoin inoin urago iban imangoc. Worocha tongga son nuc sonihon youpno angsoworengitninga. Muno son ambarac sonin sonin youpsoni worocgon soworengitnung. Tongo amna tungu tungu inoin youpha tongo borongdeditnung.

Oro, son muyu fandat fandat amna soni ogep yangtorengitnung. Yu wömai Kopotorochon fatmata ogepma silip tong kamongidang. Tuna sonu worochon ökenneno manomano ogepma it kamangma woroc fandat fandat amnaha silip tong imongitnung.
Son ingoroc kombininga: Kopotoroc ogep tonguc yeantamon yo. Woi muno sinom, amna auho toroc kiap guroc ngocin tongitacma, worochon urago wömai yu mit sogiangoc. Son sonihogon imanang yoningyit.

Amna au yu inoin godibohon ibibodec manomano yitno anitacma worochon toroc wömai yu boinno wömuno tanauna itonggongno öbukangoc. Wohong amna au yu Kunkun Yaruhon kiapdec manomano yitno anitacma worochon toroc wömai yu boinno ogepma tonongo itonggong koing aun feangoc.
Worocha wömai nonu kiap ogepma toctocha gapgap yonintha. Muno, non kiap ogepma kiringga koing songga itongitnahamonanu wömai non mit urago ogepma ana feangoc.

Worocha wömai nuc noni tong ogep tong imocimochon uyap au öngkung nimuna non muyu worocdecgon ongitnahamon. Oröc noni noniot Yesuha kombing tobing imongidangma yuha wömai toup sinom kombingmanaina kiap ogepmagon tong imongitnahamon.
Nocho mata madango ngo nakain obunadec irim tat. Aarut, nochon obu irim kiap woi moröma sinom tongitat.

Oro, amna au yu sonthon godip soni macmacha toup kiringga irot soni sakang kamongidang. Wohong yu wömai ‘owi amnaho yangamin ma moröma sogitna’ yongo godibhon manomanohagon kombingidang. O yu Yuda nanohon amna morömaha botongga ‘yu non dongyu moin toningyit’ yongo Yesu nontha ep görudec ombocma worochon foro öp singidang.

Amna godibo macmacyi idangma yui sonthon godip soni macmacha toup kiriang mahong yu ino wömai gendic nongoru fodingidang. Yu toup kiringidangma worochon foro wömai ingoroc: Yuhon nucni auyai son amna worochon mata sumboda godip soni maupma wömai kiap worocho yu ma moröma imun.

Worochoi oro, noc Pol, ‘nocu yapmu tunguhagon ma moröma sogiwa’ yongo kombihat. Woi Moröma noni Yesu Duic, yu ‘nontha’ yongga ep goröcdec omboc. Worocha tongga gurochon ibibo nochon kombic kombicdec ihorocgon omboc. Tongo worocho noc wönggon manangtoreic.

Oro, amna auho godibo macmacyi intha woha godibo ma-macmacyi inthu woi yapmu boinno muno. Kiap tunguhogon wömai yapmu boinno itac, woi Kopotorocho itonggong wego tun öngkung nimogocma worocgon wömai yapmu moröma sinom.
Owi amna ambaracho kiap worocha kombiuya boinno itac, yu woi Kopotorochon Israel nano boinno idang, yuho irot gucot idarut.
Oro nocho mata madango ingoroc kantiwa: Amna auho wönggon mepmo au namoninga. Muno, Yesuhon youpha tongga nocho urop mepmo moröma yaa fedidang. Worochon dipmo urop nochon godibnadec idang.
Oro oröcnai, Moröma noni Yesu Duic yuhon banac banacnoho soniot itun. Woi boinno.
